description: This is a test source file for the VideoDetailsViewModel, containing unit tests that verify the behavior of the 'reduceOptimisticToggle' method, especially toggling liked state and adjusting likes count.

classes.name: VideoDetailsViewModelTest
classes.description: Test class for VideoDetailsViewModel, containing unit tests for toggling like status and ensuring likes count invariants.

methods.name: reduceOptimisticToggle_fromUnliked_incrementsCountAndSetsLiked
methods.description: Tests toggling from an unliked to liked state, expecting likes count to increment and liked status to set to true.

methods.name: reduceOptimisticToggle_fromLiked_decrementsCountAndUnsetsLiked
methods.description: Tests toggling from a liked to unliked state, expecting likes count to decrement and liked status to set to false.

methods.name: reduceOptimisticToggle_neverBelowZero
methods.description: Ensures that toggling from a liked state with zero likes does not result in negative likes count.
